_meta.notes: Merged configuration: Combined original N100 service endpoints with v9 autonomous orchestration logic.

kilo_cli.description: Delegate autonomous coding tasks through the Kilo v9 autonomous loop. Kilo runs a 9-stage pipeline: /architect plans, /orchestrator executes via /code + /debug + /review + /ask, a semantic guard with 11 gates protects the workspace, and a 5-store memory system ensures cross-task continuity. Use this for anything that requires writing, testing, iterating, or debugging code.

task_schema.context: Stack, file paths, constraints, auth strategy, DB schema, env vars, related prior tasks
task_schema.parent_task: uuid of parent task if subtask, else null
task_schema.memory_refs: comma-separated prior task IDs whose .kilo/history/ entries are relevant

include_in_context: Target shell: bash 5.x / sh / zsh — specify
Execution environment: cron | systemd | manual | Docker entrypoint
Dependencies allowed: curl | jq | awk | sed | python3 — specify which
Secrets: env vars only — never hardcode
Framework: Express | Fastify | Next.js | FastAPI | Flask — specify
Auth strategy: JWT | session+cookie | OAuth2 | API key
Database: PostgreSQL | MySQL | SQLite | MongoDB — ORM or raw
Vector store: Qdrant | Pgvector | Weaviate | Chroma — specify
invariants_to_enforce: Auth checks never removed from protected routes
All DB queries parameterised — no string interpolation
Secrets only from env vars — never hardcoded
Vector store collection schema never modified without migration

always_delegate_to_kilo: Write any new application, service, or module
Build or extend a REST / tRPC / GraphQL API
Implement auth — JWT, session, OAuth2, API key middleware
Set up or extend a database schema — ORM models, migrations, indexes
Integrate Ollama / OpenAI / Anthropic / LangChain / LangGraph
Fix a bug by iterating through errors
Write and run unit, integration, or smoke tests
handle_directly: Smart home control — use home_assistant skill
Simple file reads or configuration checks
Planning and breaking tasks into subtasks
delegate_then_supervise: Multi-service implementations — break into ordered subtasks
Auth implementation — Kilo writes middleware, OpenClaw verifies invariants
Deployment scripts — Kilo writes scripts, OpenClaw reviews before execution
never_delegate_to_kilo: Executing destructive DB operations on production data
Pushing to git remote — OpenClaw stages and confirms first

autonomous_behavior.on_task_completed: Read result from signal file. Extract: files_created, files_modified, gate_results, fix_source. Report to user.
autonomous_behavior.on_task_failed: Read failure signal. Extract: error_class, strategy_attempted. If attempts < max: reformulate and requeue. If convergence_exit=true: escalate to user.
autonomous_behavior.on_gate_rejection: Read gate failure from signal. If T2: requeue with gate context. If T1: escalate to user immediately.

home_assistant.description: Control smart home devices, read sensor states, trigger automations.

supervised.description: All structural and invariant changes require human approval.
supervised.behavior: Block on T1/T2 gate failures and significant writer decisions.

graduated.description: Deterministic changes auto-promote; semantic changes route to staging.
graduated.behavior: Quarantine difficult tasks; continue pipeline for corroborated hits.
